message.jaymoskingdoms.mote.offer: A mote of the court's light, shut in your lantern? It never wants oil, never gutters. %s, and it's yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mote.poor: %s, friend. Come back when your purse is heavier.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mote.done: There. It will burn when we are both long gone.
